audit_target: F5 Root048 compact equilibrium source definitions

constants_hswl_auto_value.finding: ReadXmlElementAuto unconditionally queries 'value' attribute without optional fallback, throwing run exception if 'value' attribute is omitted even when auto='true'. Root048 fix value='0' is strictly confirmed necessary.

constants_rhopgradient.finding: Value 2 maps to RHOG_WaterCol (hydrostatic water column density gradient), which matches the physical initialization requirements of sloped beach equilibrium.

solver_simulationdomain_incz_conflict.code_snippet: if(!eparms.IsPosDefault() && resizeold)Run_ExceptioonFile("Combination of <simulationdomain> with IncZ or DomainFixedXXX in <parameters> section of XML is not allowed.",FileXml);
solver_simulationdomain_incz_conflict.finding: Explicit domain definition inside <simulationdomain> is mutually exclusive with IncZ / DomainFixedXXX parameters. Root048 removal of IncZ resolves fatal solver initialization exception.

parameters_saveposdouble_vs_posdouble.finding: PosDouble is officially deprecated; SavePosDouble value='1' is canonical modern keyword.

parameters_minfluidstop_vs_partsoutmax.code_snippet: if(eparms.Exists("PartsOutMax"))Log->PrintWarning("The XML option 'PartsOutMax' is deprecated. Use 'MinFluidStop' option."); MinFluidStop=eparms.GetValueFloat("MinFluidStop",true,0);
parameters_minfluidstop_vs_partsoutmax.finding: PartsOutMax is officially deprecated; MinFluidStop value='0' is canonical modern keyword.

motion_syntax.finding: Tag <mvpredef id='1' duration='16'> with child <file name='...' fields='2' fieldtime='0' fieldx='1' /> and event <begin mov='1' start='0.00' finish='16' /> strictly matches the C++ parser.

gauges_swl_points.finding: Gauge <swl> takes only <point0> (initial) and <point2> (final). The tag <point1> present in Root048 is completely ignored by the parser and represents an invalid/vestigial attribute.

gauges_underscored_intervals.finding: Tags with leading underscores (e.g. <_computedt>, <_computetime>, <_outputdt>, <_outputtime>) are completely ignored by the parser, falling back to CfgDefault values. Patched source restores canonical active tag names.

clipplane_retained_fluid_semantics.finding: In GenCase, ClipPoint evaluates PlanePoint = (p - pt) . v_unit. If PlanePoint > 0, the function jumps to 0x4f6aa0 returning 0 (point discarded/clipped). If PlanePoint <= 0, the point is kept. The vector v points in the direction of the half-space to be removed. Root048 specified vector (-0.28, 0, 1.00), which pointed upwards into the fluid, discarding all fluid above the continuous bed and retaining fluid underneath the slope (empirical QA049 failure: 10,860 fluid particles below bed). The mathematically and empirically required vector is (0.28, 0, -1.00).
